rows: Classic dry traditional using wildflower honey. Staggered nutrient additions at 24h, 48h, and 72h.
Raspberry and lingonberry melomel. Secondary fermentation on fruit for 2 weeks.
Apple cider and honey cyser. Used fresh-pressed cider from local orchard.
Spiced with cardamom, cloves, and cinnamon. Aged 6 months on oak.
